1.english_reference: To the chief Musician , A Psalm of David .

traditions.LXX: Εἰς τὸ τέλος · ψαλμὸς τῷ Δαυείδ .
traditions.VUL: In finem , psalmus David .
traditions.KJV: To the chief Musician , A Psalm of David .

1.english_reference: O LORD , thou hast searched me , and known [ me ] .

traditions.LXX: Κύριε , ἐδοκίμασάς με καὶ ἔγνως με ·
traditions.VUL: Dómine probásti me , et cognovísti me :
traditions.KJV: O LORD , thou hast searched me , and known [ me ] .

2.english_reference: Thou knowest my downsitting and mine uprising ,

traditions.WLC: אַתָּ֣ה יָ֭דַעְתָּ שִׁבְתִּ֣ י וְ קוּמִ֑ י
traditions.LXX: σὺ ἔγνως τὴν καθέδραν μου καὶ τὴν ἔγερσίν μου ,
traditions.VUL: tu cognovísti sessiónem meam , et resurrectiónem meam .
traditions.KJV: Thou knowest my downsitting and mine uprising ,

2.english_reference: thou understandest my thought afar off .

traditions.WLC: בַּ֥נְתָּה לְ֝ רֵעִ֗ י מֵ רָחֽוֹק
traditions.LXX: σὺ συνῆκας πάντας τοὺς διαλογισμούς μου ἀπὸ μακρόθεν ·
traditions.KJV: thou understandest my thought afar off .

4.english_reference: For [ there is ] not a word in my tongue ,

traditions.WLC: כִּ֤י אֵ֣ין מִ֭לָּה בִּ לְשׁוֹנִ֑ י
traditions.LXX: ὅτι οὐκ ἔστιν λόγος ἄδικος ἐν γλώσσῃ μου ·
traditions.VUL: Et omnes vias meas prævidísti : quia non est sermo in lingua mea .
traditions.KJV: For [ there is ] not a word in my tongue , [ but ] ,

4.english_reference: [ but ] , lo , O LORD , thou knowest it altogether .

traditions.LXX: ἰδού , Κύριε , σὺ ἔγνως πάντα
traditions.KJV: lo , O LORD , thou knowest it altogether .

5.english_reference: Thou hast beset me behind and before ,

traditions.LXX: τὰ ἔσχατα καὶ τὰ ἀρχαῖα ·
traditions.VUL: Ecce Dómine tu cognovísti ómnia novíssima , et antíqua :
traditions.KJV: Thou hast beset me behind and before ,

5.english_reference: and laid thine hand upon me .

traditions.WLC: וַ תָּ֖שֶׁת עָלַ֣ י כַּפֶּֽ כָה
traditions.LXX: σὺ ἔπλασάς με καὶ ἔθηκας ἐπ᾽ ἐμὲ τὴν χεῖρά σου .
traditions.VUL: tu formásti me , et posuísti super me manum tuam .
traditions.KJV: and laid thine hand upon me .

6.english_reference: [ Such ] knowledge [ is ] too wonderful for me ;

traditions.LXX: ἐθαυμαστώθη ἡ γνῶσίς σου ἐξ ἐμοῦ ·
traditions.VUL: Mirábilis facta est sciéntia tua ex me :
traditions.KJV: [ Such ] knowledge [ is ] too wonderful for me ;

6.english_reference: it is high , I can not [ attain ] unto it .

traditions.LXX: ἐκραταιώθη , οὐ μὴ δύνωμαι πρὸς αὐτήν .
traditions.VUL: confortáta est , et non pótero ad eam .
traditions.KJV: it is high , I can not [ attain ] unto it .

7.english_reference: Whither shall I go from thy spirit ?

traditions.LXX: ποῦ πορευθῶ ἀπὸ τοῦ πνεύματός σου ;
traditions.VUL: Quo ibo a spíritu tuo ?
traditions.KJV: Whither shall I go from thy spirit ?

7.english_reference: or whither shall I flee from thy presence ?

traditions.WLC: וְ֝ אָ֗נָה מִ פָּנֶ֥י ךָ אֶבְרָֽח
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἀπὸ τοῦ προσώπου σου ποῦ φύγω ;
traditions.VUL: et quo a fácie tua fúgiam ?
traditions.KJV: or whither shall I flee from thy presence ?

8.english_reference: If I ascend up into heaven , thou [ art ] there :

traditions.LXX: ἐὰν ἀναβῶ εἰς τὸν οὐρανόν , σὺ εἶ ἐκεῖ ·
traditions.VUL: Si ascéndero in cælum , tu illic es :
traditions.KJV: If I ascend up into heaven , thou [ art ] there :

8.english_reference: if I make my bed in hell , behold , thou [ art there ] .

traditions.LXX: ἐὰν καταβῶ εἰς τὸν ᾅδην , πάρει ·
traditions.VUL: si descéndero in inférnum , ades .
traditions.KJV: if I make my bed in hell , behold , thou [ art there ] .

9.english_reference: [ If ] I take the wings of the morning ,

traditions.LXX: ἐὰν ἀναλάβω τὰς πτέρυγάς μου κατ᾽ ὀρθὸν
traditions.VUL: Si súmpsero pennas meas dilúculo ,
traditions.KJV: [ If ] I take the wings of the morning , [ and ]

9.english_reference: [ and ] dwell in the uttermost parts of the sea ;

traditions.LXX: καὶ κατασκηνώσω εἰς τὰ ἔσχατα τῆς θαλάσσης ,
traditions.VUL: et habitávero in extrémis maris :
traditions.KJV: dwell in the uttermost parts of the sea ;

10.english_reference: Even there shall thy hand lead me ,

traditions.WLC: גַּם שָׁ֭ם יָדְ ךָ֣ תַנְחֵ֑ נִי
traditions.LXX: καὶ γὰρ ἐκεῖ ἡ χείρ σου ὁδηγήσει με ,
traditions.VUL: étenim illuc manus tua dedúcet me :
traditions.KJV: Even there shall thy hand lead me ,

10.english_reference: and thy right hand shall hold me .

traditions.LXX: καὶ καθέξει με ἡ δεξιά σου .
traditions.VUL: et tenébit me déxtera tua .
traditions.KJV: and thy right hand shall hold me .

11.english_reference: If I say , Surely the darkness shall cover me

traditions.WLC: וָ֭ אֹמַר אַךְ חֹ֣שֶׁךְ יְשׁוּפֵ֑ נִי
traditions.LXX: καὶ εἶπα Ἄρα σκότος καταπατήσει με ,
traditions.VUL: Et dixi : Fórsitan ténebræ conculcábunt me :
traditions.KJV: If I say , Surely the darkness shall cover me ;

11.english_reference: even the night shall be light about me

traditions.LXX: καὶ νὺξ φωτισμὸς ἐν τῇ τρυφῇ μου ·
traditions.VUL: et nox illuminátio mea in delíciis meis .
traditions.KJV: even the night shall be light about me .

12.english_reference: Yea , the darkness hideth not from thee

traditions.WLC: גַּם חֹשֶׁךְ֮ לֹֽא יַחְשִׁ֪יךְ מִ֫מֶּ֥ ךָ
traditions.VUL: Quia ténebræ non obscurabúntur a te ,
traditions.KJV: Yea , the darkness hideth not from thee ;

12.english_reference: but the night shineth as the day

traditions.VUL: et nox sicut dies illuminábitur :
traditions.KJV: but the night shineth as the day :

12.english_reference: the darkness and the light [ are ] both alike [ to thee ]

traditions.LXX: ὡς τὸ σκότος αὐτῆς , οὕτως καὶ τὸ φῶς αὐτῆς .
traditions.VUL: sicut ténebræ eius , ita et lumen eius .
traditions.KJV: the darkness and the light [ are ] both alike [ to thee ] .

13.english_reference: For thou hast possessed my reins

traditions.LXX: ὅτι σὺ ἐκτήσω τοὺς νεφρούς μου , Κύριε ,
traditions.VUL: Quia tu possedísti renes meos :
traditions.KJV: For thou hast possessed my reins :

13.english_reference: thou hast covered me in my mother ’s womb

traditions.WLC: תְּ֝סֻכֵּ֗ נִי בְּ בֶ֣טֶן אִמִּֽ י
traditions.LXX: ἀντελάβου μου ἐκ γαστρὸς μητρός μου .
traditions.VUL: suscepísti me de útero matris meæ .
traditions.KJV: thou hast covered me in my mother ’s womb .

traditions.LXX: ἐξομολογήσομαί σοι ,
traditions.VUL: Confitébor tibi
traditions.KJV: I will praise thee ;

14.english_reference: for I am fearfully [ and ] wonderfully made

traditions.LXX: ὅτι φοβερῶς ἐθαυμαστώθης ·
traditions.VUL: quia terribíliter magnificátus es :
traditions.KJV: for I am fearfully [ and ] wonderfully made :

traditions.LXX: θαυμάσια τὰ ἔργα σου ,
traditions.VUL: mirabília ópera tua ,
traditions.KJV: marvellous [ are ] thy works ;

14.english_reference: and [ that ] my soul knoweth right well

traditions.LXX: καὶ ἡ ψυχή μου γινώσκει σφόδρα .
traditions.VUL: et ánima mea cognóscit nimis .
traditions.KJV: and [ that ] my soul knoweth right well .

15.english_reference: My substance was not hid from thee

traditions.WLC: לֹא נִכְחַ֥ד עָצְמִ֗ י מִ֫מֶּ֥ ךָּ
traditions.LXX: οὐκ ἐκρύβη τὸ ὀστοῦν μου ἀπὸ σοῦ
traditions.VUL: Non est occultátum os meum a te ,
traditions.KJV: My substance was not hid from thee ,

15.english_reference: when I was made in secret

traditions.LXX: ὃ ἐποίησας ἐν κρυφῇ ,
traditions.VUL: quod fecísti in occúlto :
traditions.KJV: when I was made in secret , [ and ]

15.english_reference: curiously wrought in the lowest parts of the earth

traditions.LXX: καὶ ἡ ὑπόστασίς μου ἐν τοῖς κατωτάτω τῆς γῆς ·
traditions.VUL: et substántia mea in inferióribus terræ .
traditions.KJV: curiously wrought in the lowest parts of the earth .

16.english_reference: Thine eyes did see my substance , yet being unperfect

traditions.LXX: τὸ ἀκατέργαστόν σου εἴδοσαν οἱ ὀφθαλμοί μου ,
traditions.VUL: Imperféctum meum vidérunt óculi tui ,
traditions.KJV: Thine eyes did see my substance , yet being unperfect ;

16.english_reference: and in thy book all [ my members ] were written

traditions.WLC: וְ עַֽל סִפְרְ ךָ֮ כֻּלָּ֪ ם יִכָּ֫תֵ֥בוּ
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἐπὶ τὸ βιβλίον σου πάντες γραφήσονται ·
traditions.VUL: et in libro tuo omnes scribéntur :
traditions.KJV: and in thy book all [ my members ] were written , [

traditions.LXX: ἡμέρας πλασθήσονται ,
traditions.VUL: dies formabúntur ,
traditions.KJV: which ] in continuance were fashioned ,

16.english_reference: when [ as yet there was ] none of them

traditions.LXX: καὶ οὐδεὶς ἐν αὐτοῖς .
traditions.VUL: et nemo in eis .
traditions.KJV: when [ as yet there was ] none of them .

17.english_reference: How precious also are thy thoughts unto me , O God !

traditions.WLC: וְ לִ֗ י מַה יָּקְר֣וּ רֵעֶ֣י ךָ אֵ֑ל
traditions.LXX: ἐμοὶ δὲ λίαν ἐτιμήθησαν οἱ φίλοι σου , ὁ θεός ·
traditions.VUL: Mihi autem nimis honorificáti sunt amíci tui , Deus :
traditions.KJV: How precious also are thy thoughts unto me , O God !
traditions.DSS: ו ל׳י מה יקרו רעי׳ך אל

17.english_reference: how great is the sum of them !

traditions.LXX: λίαν ἐκραταιώθησαν αἱ ἀρχαὶ αὐτῶν ·
traditions.VUL: nimis confortátus est principátus eórum .
traditions.KJV: how great is the sum of them !

18.english_reference: [ If ] I should count them , they are more in number than the sand

traditions.WLC: אֶ֭סְפְּרֵ ם מֵ ח֣וֹל יִרְבּ֑וּ ן
traditions.LXX: ἐξαριθμήσομαι αὐτοὺς καὶ ὑπὲρ ἄμμον πληθυνθήσονται ·
traditions.VUL: Dinumerábo eos , et super arénam multiplicabúntur :
traditions.KJV: [ If ] I should count them , they are more in number than the sand :

18.english_reference: when I awake , I am still with thee

traditions.WLC: הֱ֝קִיצֹ֗תִי וְ עוֹדִ֥ י עִמָּֽ ךְ
traditions.LXX: ἐξηγέρθην , καὶ ἔτι εἰμὶ μετὰ σοῦ .
traditions.VUL: exsurréxi , et adhuc sum tecum .
traditions.KJV: when I awake , I am still with thee .

19.english_reference: Surely thou wilt slay the wicked , O God

traditions.LXX: ἐὰν ἀποκτείνῃς ἁμαρτωλούς , ὁ θεός ·
traditions.VUL: Si occíderis Deus peccatóres :
traditions.KJV: Surely thou wilt slay the wicked , O God :

19.english_reference: depart from me therefore , ye bloody men

traditions.WLC: וְ אַנְשֵׁ֥י דָ֝מִ֗ים ס֣וּרוּ מֶֽ נִּי
traditions.LXX: ἄνδρες αἱμάτων , ἐκκλίνατε ἀπ᾽ ἐμοῦ .
traditions.VUL: viri sánguinum declináte a me :
traditions.KJV: depart from me therefore , ye bloody men .

20.english_reference: For they speak against thee wickedly

traditions.LXX: ὅτι ἔρεις εἰς διαλογισμόν ·
traditions.VUL: quia dícitis in cogitatióne :
traditions.KJV: For they speak against thee wickedly , [

traditions.LXX: λήμψονται εἰς ματαιότητα τὰς πόλεις σου .
traditions.VUL: Accípient in vanitáte civitátes tuas .
traditions.KJV: and ] thine enemies take [ thy name ] in vain .

21.english_reference: Do not I hate them , O LORD , that hate thee ?

traditions.WLC: הֲ לֽוֹא מְשַׂנְאֶ֖י ךָ יְהוָ֥ה אֶשְׂנָ֑א
traditions.LXX: οὐχὶ τοὺς μισοῦντάς σε , Κύριε , ἐμίσησα ,
traditions.VUL: Nonne qui odérunt te Dómine , óderam :
traditions.KJV: Do not I hate them , O LORD , that hate thee ?

traditions.LXX: καὶ ἐπὶ τοῖς ἐχθροῖς σου ἐξετηκόμην ;
traditions.VUL: et super inimícos tuos tabescébam ?
traditions.KJV: and am not I grieved with those that rise up against thee ?

22.english_reference: I hate them with perfect hatred :

traditions.LXX: τέλειον μῖσος ἐμίσουν αὐτούς ,
traditions.VUL: Perfécto ódio óderam illos :
traditions.KJV: I hate them with perfect hatred :

traditions.LXX: εἰς ἐχθροὺς ἐγένοντό μοι .
traditions.VUL: et inimíci facti sunt mihi .
traditions.KJV: I count them mine enemies .

23.english_reference: Search me , O God , and know my heart :

traditions.LXX: δοκίμασόν με , ὁ θεός , καὶ γνῶθι τὴν καρδίαν μου ·
traditions.VUL: Proba me Deus , et scito cor meum :
traditions.KJV: Search me , O God , and know my heart :

traditions.LXX: ἔτασόν με καὶ γνῶθι τὰς τρίβους μου ·
traditions.VUL: intérroga me , et cognósce sémitas meas .
traditions.KJV: try me , and know my thoughts :
